insert into mst_unit_conv (comp_cd, item_id, from_unit, to_unit, factor, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{itemId}, #{fromUnit}, #{toUnit}, #{factor}, #{by}, #{by}) on conflict (comp_cd, item_id, from_unit) do update set to_unit = excluded.to_unit, factor = excluded.factor, use_yn = 'Y', row_ver = mst_unit_conv.row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by where mst_unit_conv.use_yn = 'N' returning conv_id

mapper.select: select from mst_bom b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.item_id = #{itemId} and b.alt_no = 1 and b.status = 'RELEASED' and b.valid_from <= #{date} and (b.valid_to is null or #{date} < b.valid_to)

with recursive eff as materialized ( select b.bom_id, b.item_id, b.base_qty, b.rev from mst_bom b where b.status = 'RELEASED' and b.alt_no = 1 and b.valid_from <= #{date} and (b.valid_to is null or #{date} < b.valid_to) ), tree as ( select 1 as lvl, h.bom_id, h.rev as bom_rev, l.line_id, l.line_no, h.item_id as parent_id, l.item_id, l.line_type, l.qty, l.unit_cd as line_unit, h.base_qty, l.scrap_pct, l.fixed_yn, l.issue_method, l.alt_grp, l.alt_priority, l.alt_pct, l.op_seq, l.position, coalesce(c.factor, case when l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 end) as factor, round((case when l.fixed_yn = 'Y' then l.qty else l.qty / h.base_qty * cast(#{qty} as numeric) end) * (1 + l.scrap_pct / 100) * coalesce(c.factor, 1) * coalesce(l.alt_pct / 100, 1), 20) as req_qty, array[h.item_id, l.item_id] as items, array[lpad(l.line_no::text, 4, '0') || lpad(l.line_id::text, 14, '0')] as ord, (l.item_id = h.item_id) as cycle from mst_bom h join mst_bom_line l on l.bom_id = h.bom_id
where h.bom_id = #{rootBomId} union all select t.lvl + 1, e.bom_id, e.rev, l.line_id, l.line_no, e.item_id, l.item_id, l.line_type, l.qty, l.unit_cd, e.base_qty, l.scrap_pct, l.fixed_yn, l.issue_method, l.alt_grp, l.alt_priority, l.alt_pct, l.op_seq, l.position, coalesce(c.factor, case when l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 end), round((case when l.fixed_yn = 'Y' then l.qty else l.qty / e.base_qty * t.req_qty end) * (1 + l.scrap_pct / 100) * coalesce(c.factor, 1) * coalesce(l.alt_pct / 100, 1), 20), t.items || l.item_id, t.ord || (lpad(l.line_no::text, 4, '0') || lpad(l.line_id::text, 14, '0')), l.item_id = any(t.items) from tree t join eff e on e.item_id = t.item_id join mst_bom_line l on l.bom_id = e.bom_id
where not t.cycle and t.line_type <> 'BYPRODUCT' and t.lvl < #{depthLimit} ), capped as (select * from tree limit #{rowLimit}) select t.lvl, t.bom_id, t.bom_rev, t.line_id, t.line_no, p.item_cd as parent_cd, t.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.spec, i.item_type, t.line_type, t.qty, t.line_unit, t.base_qty, t.scrap_pct, t.fixed_yn, t.factor, round(t.req_qty, 12) as req_qty, i.unit_cd as item_unit, t.issue_method, t.alt_grp, t.alt_priority, t.alt_pct, t.op_seq, t.position, ce.rev as child_rev, (t.factor is null) as no_conv, t.cycle from capped t join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id join mst_item p on p.item_id = t.parent_id left join eff ce on ce.item_id = t.item_id order by t.ord

choose.otherwise: b.status = 'RELEASED' and b.valid_from <= #{date} and (b.valid_to is null or #{date} < b.valid_to)

mapper.select: with recursive up as ( select 1 as lvl, b.bom_id, b.rev, b.status, b.valid_from, b.valid_to, b.item_id as parent_id, l.item_id as child_id, l.line_no, l.line_type, l.qty, l.unit_cd as line_unit, b.base_qty, array[l.item_id, b.item_id] as items, array[rpad(p.item_cd, 40) || b.rev || lpad(l.line_id::text, 14, '0')] as ord, (b.item_id = l.item_id) as cycle from mst_bom_line l join mst_bom b on b.bom_id = l.bom_id join mst_item p on p.item_id = b.item_id where l.item_id = #{itemId} and union all select u.lvl + 1, b.bom_id, b.rev, b.status, b.valid_from, b.valid_to, b.item_id, l.item_id, l.line_no, l.line_type, l.qty, l.unit_cd, b.base_qty, u.items || b.item_id, u.ord || (rpad(p.item_cd, 40) || b.rev || lpad(l.line_id::text, 14, '0')), b.item_id = any(u.items) from up u join mst_bom_line l on l.item_id = u.parent_id join mst_bom b on b.bom_id = l.bom_id join mst_item p on p.item_id = b.item_id where not u.cycle and u.lvl < #{depthLimit} and ), capped as (select * from up limit #{rowLimit}) select u.lvl, u.bom_id, u.rev, u.status, u.valid_from, u.valid_to, u.parent_id, p.item_cd as parent_cd, p.item_nm as parent_nm, p.item_type as parent_type, u.child_id, c.item_cd as child_cd, u.line_no, u.line_type, u.qty, u.line_unit, u.base_qty, u.cycle from capped u join mst_item p on p.item_id = u.parent_id join mst_item c on c.item_id = u.child_id order by u.ord
